decisionsTitle: «Ziua cursei» in three tabs — «Prezența», «Clasament», «Lucruri de adus» — and the walk-in picks a free spare
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-18, three days before the race, with screenshots of the desk:** «Pentru "Ziua Cursei" vreau un tab pentru "Clasament", ce am acum pe aceasta pagina e de fapt "Prezenta"» · «Aici cand adaug pe cineva, trebuie sa pot selecta din acele BIB-uri goale (de rezerva) care momentan sunt intre 155 si 163, trebuie sa si afisez undeva asta» · «de asemenea un alt tab pentru ziua cursei unde sa bifam "lucruri de adus" un fel de inventar, unde sa punem : prelungitoare, markere, etc» · «trebuie sa faci aceste schimbari eficient si rapid!»

**Decision — three tabs.** «Ziua cursei» (`/admin/checkin`) gets the house's row of sub-tabs (`SubNav fits`, §360, §974), plain links drawn on the server, the current one marked (`aria-current`), never on paper: «Prezența» — the desk exactly as it was (§67, its rows, verbs and title untouched) —, «Clasament» — the chosen event's results pages (§808: `/admin/events/[id]/results` and «Sosire») — and «Lucruri de adus», new. Each carries the event chosen on the page (the desk's select; on a results page, the page's own event); with none chosen the desk and the list pick their default as the desk does, and «Clasament», which has no page without an event, is not drawn. A tab whose page the viewer's role cannot open is not drawn — «Clasament» is `canEnterResults`' (the Organizer and the Administrators), so the desk Volunteer, the Redactor and Tehnic see two tabs — and every page still asserts its own gate (BR-REQ-060-01). The top nav keeps «Ziua cursei» lit on `/admin/checkin/lucruri` (under the desk's path); the results pages keep their place in it.

**Decision — the spares, shown and picked (§444).** Beside the desk's counts, under «Adaugă pe cineva», one line for the chosen event from `freeSpareBibNumbers`: «Numere de rezervă libere (9): 155–163», runs of consecutive numbers as ranges («155–158, 160, 162–163»), each written as the event's bibs print it (`formatRaceNumber`); when the club reserved none, that an Administrator prints them from «Alocare și tipărire»; when every one was given, the desk's existing words. The same line stands on the walk-in's form opened from the desk. Its «Numărul dat acum» (fast track only, as before) is, while the event has free spares, a native select of them, lowest first and the lowest chosen — the number proposed before —, then «Alt număr…» (the typed box, as before) and «Fără număr acum» (posts none: the site draws one, §548). Without spares, or opened from the list, it is the box as it always was. The server is unchanged: it receives a number or none, and refuses a number given meanwhile.

**Decision — «Lucruri de adus».** A per-event checklist of the things the organizers bring to the race (`event_race_day_items`, migration `0214`, expand only: a label of 1–120 characters, an optional note of at most 200 — «3 bucăți», «le aduce Ana» —, whether it was brought, by whom and when, its place in the list). Reading and ticking: every staff role that works the desk (`canWorkTheDesk`, the desk's own gate). Adding, changing and deleting: the Organizer and the Administrators (`canManageVolunteers`, whoever runs the race's people and its plan); asserted in each action and again in the service. A tick posts the state it wants, never a toggle — a double press saves the same — and stamps who and when, cleared when unticked. At most 200 things an event (`RACE_DAY_ITEMS_FULL`). One audit row a change (`event.race_day_item_added`, `_edited`, `_removed`, `_brought`, `_unbrought`), the item's id alone. The page: the tabs, the desk's event select, the counts («2 lucruri · 1 adus»), a row a thing — the house's `TickButton` (44 pixels, a plain form, works without scripts), the note, a brought row greyed with «adus · {name} · {ora}» in the club's time; for the writers the row's pencil fold (§842) and «Șterge», asked first naming the thing —, then «Adaugă un lucru» (an `ActionForm`: a refusal names its box and keeps what was typed), open by itself while the list is empty. Printed, it is the list as a checklist, no control. Nothing public; no series edit, repeat, duplicate or event file carries it; it goes with the event.

**Left out.** Copying a list from another event (or from last year's race) — a later ask; for now each race's list is typed once. Reordering the things by hand: a new thing goes last. The desk's rows and verbs, which another change was editing at the same time. A tick written on the printed list back into the site: the paper is a copy to carry, the page holds the ticks.
changelogLine: - **«Ziua cursei» in three tabs** — «Prezența» (the desk as it was), «Clasament» (the chosen race's results) and «Lucruri de adus», a per-event checklist of what to bring, ticked on the day; the desk lists the free spare numbers as ranges, and «Adaugă pe cineva» picks the walk-in's number from them. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Ziua cursei», when any of its pages is drawn — the desk, «Lucruri de adus», a race's «Clasament» or «Sosire» — then three tabs stand at its top, «Prezența», «Clasament» and «Lucruri de adus», the current one marked (`aria-current`), each link carrying the chosen event, never printed; «Clasament» is not drawn without an event or for a role that cannot open the results, and the desk's rows and verbs are as before (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event with desk spares (§444), when the desk or the walk-in's form opened from it is drawn, then one line says the free ones as ranges of consecutive numbers, written as the event's bibs print them («Numere de rezervă libere (9): 155–163»), or that none were reserved, or that every one was given; and the walk-in's «Numărul dat acum» is a select of the free spares, lowest first and the lowest chosen, with «Alt număr…» (the typed box) and «Fără număr acum» (no number posted) — without spares, the box as before; the server still refuses a number given meanwhile (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Lucruri de adus» for an event, when a thing is ticked or unticked, then the press posts the state it wants — a second press saves the same and writes nothing —, a ticked thing names who ticked it and at what hour, an unticked one neither; a list holds at most 200 things (`RACE_DAY_ITEMS_FULL`), each change writes one audit row with the thing's id alone, the list goes with its event, and printed it is a checklist with no control (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Lucruri de adus», when a staff member reads or ticks the list, then every role that works the desk may and a member gets the 404; when one adds, changes or deletes a thing, then only the Organizer and the Administrators may (`canManageVolunteers`) — asserted at each action's door and again in the service, whatever the page drew (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Ziua cursei» in three tabs, «Lucruri de adus» and the walk-in's pick of a free spare
